item.title: Are war crimes being committed in the Middle East war?
item.summary: With US and Israeli strikes on Iran's critical infrastructure already underway Tuesday amid threats of more to come, the UN and other organisations have warned that such attacks could constitute war crimes.

item.title: Iran-backed Iraqi armed group releases kidnapped US journalist
item.summary: An Iran-backed Iraqi armed group has released an American journalist abducted in Baghdad last week, an Iraqi official said on Tuesday. The group had earlier agreed to release the journalist in a gesture of goodwill toward Iraq’s outgoing prime minister.

item.title: Shootout outside Israeli consulate in Istanbul
item.summary: A gunman was killed and two others wounded in a shootout Tuesday with police outside the Israeli consulate in Istanbul, the local governor said, adding that two officers were lightly wounded. It was not immediately clear if the intended target was the Israeli consulate.

item.title: Trump threatens to take out Iran in 'one night' as deadline looms
item.summary: US President Donald Trump said Monday he’s “not at all” concerned about committing possible war crimes as he again threatened to destroy Iran’s bridges and power plants if Tehran does not meet his Tuesday 8pm ET deadline to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
